analyst.title: Technical & Macro Analyst
analyst.description: [Quick take]: Reads pure candlestick price action and computes quantitative indicators such as moving averages (EMA), relative strength (RSI) and average true range (ATR) to judge whether the market is in a strong uptrend, a strong downtrend, or a choppy sideways range.

sentiment.title: Sentiment & On-chain Whale Analyst
sentiment.description: [Quick take]: Tracks large holders' exchange deposits and withdrawals (accumulating or dumping), the Fear & Greed Index, open interest (OI) and stablecoin minting, to avoid bull traps and liquidation cascades.

bull.title: Lead Bull Researcher
bull.description: [Quick take]: The "for" side of the long/short debate. Hunts for every clue pointing higher, makes a firm case for going long, estimates a take-profit target and works out a sensible risk/reward ratio.

bear.title: Bear Skeptic Researcher
bear.description: [Quick take]: The "against" side and fault-finder of the debate. However good things look, it digs out hidden risks — overhead supply, Fed (FOMC) rate meetings, fake breakouts — and keeps the team on defense.

moderator.title: Chief Debate Moderator
moderator.description: [Quick take]: The judge with the final say. Impartial, it runs 3 rounds of debate between the bull and bear researchers and weighs both sides' evidence to reach a final call (buy, sell, or stay flat).

strategy.title: Quant Execution Strategist
strategy.description: [Quick take]: The number-cruncher. Given the moderator's ruling, it never blindly chases with market orders: it computes the best limit price, sizes the position and stop-loss with the Kelly Criterion, and stays flat when there is no clear signal.

risk_officer.title: Compliance Risk Officer
risk_officer.description: [Quick take]: The steward. Reviews the strategist's order proposal: is the risk/reward worth it, is the stop-loss so wide it risks a blow-up, and does it break the account's portfolio rules?

hard_guard.title: Seven Iron Rules Hard Risk Guard
hard_guard.description: [Quick take]: A zero-compromise circuit breaker! Hard-coded in pure Python — even if the LLM goes rogue, hallucinates or wants to short the planet, this firewall pulls the plug within a microsecond the moment a single check fails!

alert_notifier.title: 24/7 Event & Circuit-Breaker Notifier
alert_notifier.description: [Quick take]: The round-the-clock messenger. Whenever the system trips a circuit breaker, fills an order or sees a cross-exchange price spike, it pushes an alert to your phone via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram within 0.5 seconds!
